description: Roof inspection form completed by a licensed inspector for a property insurance underwriter: the property and policy, the predominant and secondary roof's covering, age, remaining life, permit and update history, overall condition, visible damage and leaks, and the inspector's certification.

applicant_name.description: Applicant/Insured Name written at the top of the form.

policy_number.description: Application/Policy # written at the top of the form.

address_inspected.description: Address Inspected: the full property address as written.

inspection_date.description: Date of Inspection, as written on the form (e.g. 7/6/18).

predominant_roof.description: The Predominant Roof column of the Roof section.

remaining_useful_life_years.description: Remaining useful life (years), as a number.

last_permit_date.description: Date of last roofing permit, exactly as written (may be a year only).

last_update_date.description: Date of last update as written; an empty string if the blank is not filled in.

update_type.description: Which 'If updated (check one)' box is marked with an X. 'Not updated' when neither box is marked: an empty box does not count.

overall_condition.description: Which Overall condition box is marked with an X; 'Not marked' if neither.

visible_damage.description: Every checked box under 'Any visible signs of damage / deterioration?', using the printed label (e.g. Visible hail damage). Empty if none checked.

visible_leaks.description: Any visible signs of leaks? true if Yes is checked, false if No is checked, null if neither.

attic_underside_decking_leaks.description: Attic/underside of decking: true if Yes is checked, false if No, null if neither.

interior_ceilings_leaks.description: Interior ceilings: true if Yes is checked, false if No, null if neither.

secondary_roof_present.description: True if anything is filled in or checked in the Secondary Roof column; false if it is blank.

inspector.description: The certification block completed by the inspector.

signed.description: True if the Inspector Signature line carries a signature.

license_number.description: License Number as written, including any # prefix.

license_type.description: License Type as written, e.g. CCC.

company_name.description: Company Name of the inspection firm.

photo_count.description: Number of roof photographs on the photo page(s).
